## Event / Case name

**Neutral name for the event or process — not a conclusion.**

**Good examples:**
- `Trump-linked crypto ventures (World Liberty Financial), 2024–2026`
- `Fauci Diary release by Sen. Rand Paul, July 2026`
- `xAI acquisition of X Corp., March 2025`

**Bad examples:**
- `Trump Made a Billion Dollars on Crypto` ← asserts the conclusion in the title
- `The Big Cover-Up` ← editorial, not descriptive

Your name:

## Date range

Example: `2024–2026` or `Oct 2022 – present`

## One-paragraph plain-English summary of what happened

**Describe the event. Do not ask a question and do not argue a conclusion.**

**Good example:**  
`Donald Trump and associated entities promoted and participated in crypto-related ventures, notably World Liberty Financial and related tokens announced around and after the 2024 campaign. Public materials describe token launches, promotional activity, and claimed valuations.`

**Bad example:**  
`Did Donald Trump make a fortune on crypto and was it above board?` ← question, not a summary

Your summary:

## Why this Case is needed

Link to an **active Claim** or a **clear research gap**.  
Example: `No existing Claim or Case tracks Trump-linked crypto financial flows with primary sources.`

**At least one real source is required.**

Example: `Donald Trump; World Liberty Financial; [other named entities from primary docs]`
